metadata.title: क्या विशेष जनजातियों (पीवीटीजी) की अलग जनगणना होनी चाहिए ।PVTG । The Adivasi Question
metadata.description:
There are 705 tribal groups, which are identified as scheduled tribe by the constitution of India. Out of these, 75 are known as Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups or PVTG. 2021 is a census year for India, and there was a suggestion made by a committee in 2013 to have a separate census for PVTGs in India. What were the recommendations of this committee, let's discuss in this episode of The Adivasi Question.

Anchor - Smitha Nair
